name: typesafe-ai
description: TypeSafe/Jev: Choice/Noul/Score in code, not TS types. System One judgments.
description_full: Build AI-powered software with TypeSafe System One models (Jev): Choice, Noul, and Score judgments composed in code. Not for TypeScript/Java/Rust static types, Zod, Pydantic, mypy, or JSON Schema.
body:
# Build with TypeSafe

Read live docs. Keep rules in code. Ask independent questions in one request. Always include none/other on Choice.

name: pptx
description: Create, read, edit .pptx decks, slides, notes, templates.
description_full: Create, read, and edit PowerPoint .pptx files, including slides, notes, and templates.
body:
# pptx

Use python-pptx or similar to edit existing decks and author new ones when asked to work with .pptx files.

name: xlsx
description: Create, read, edit .xlsx spreadsheets, formulas, charts.
description_full: Create, read, and edit Excel .xlsx workbooks, formulas, and charts.
body:
# xlsx

Use openpyxl to manipulate spreadsheets. Do not invent cell values; copy from source.

name: computer-use
description: Drive the user's desktop in the background — clicking, typing.
description_full: Drive the user's desktop: click, type, and screenshot GUI apps when no CLI exists.
body:
# computer-use

Only when a GUI is required. Prefer CLI tools when they exist.
